title: Square Tail Charters
specs: Boat meets all Transport Canada safety regulations
Fully licensed and Transportation Canada approved crew
includes: Entry into the Great Ontario Salmon Derby
Use of 33’ Trojan International Yacht with radar, air conditioning, bathroom, power generator, kitchenette, water and pop
blurb: Square Tail Charters offers two daily 6-hour fishing charters on Lake Ontario, departing from Port Credit, Mississauga. Guests fish for trophy salmon and trout with a fully licensed and insured crew on a 33' Trojan International Yacht equipped with modern amenities. Each booking includes entry into the Great Ontario Salmon Derby tournament.
extraNote: Dock behind the lighthouse on the South-West side of the Credit River at Lakeshore Blvd W, Port Credit, Mississauga
